claim_scope: an action-blind predictor can produce plausible average motion while failing same-state counterfactual sensitivity
an action-conditioned transition table can compose individually observed actions into held-out sequences in the deterministic fixture

code.config: standard-library learned transition-table and ASCII-frame fixture

limitations: discrete deterministic state transitions and ASCII frames rather than learned video pixels
all individual actions are observed during training; only their sequences are held out
no stochastic actors, occlusion, appearance change, collision physics, or uncertainty
